rationale: The bid-ask spread is 75 bps, which creates an immediate structural disadvantage on entry and exit. Price is at 95.9% of today's range and within 0.12% of the session high with only 3 completed 1-minute candles of data, making the risk/reward asymmetric for a long (chasing near the high) while the broader market is under pressure (-1.31% SPY, elevated VIXY) complicates a short against a stock that gapped up 2.29%. The evidence does not clearly favor either direction with sufficient conviction to justify the spread cost and early-session noise.
